result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within the same priority. I only compiled it; I didn't run any tests or check the ordering against your T-1 to T-5 example.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I replaced `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` with the same `CASE t.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END` ordering the sales rep list uses, and updated the method's Javadoc to match. The closed-ticket and region filters are unchanged.

The only caller is `RegionManagerService`, which passes the list through as is.
